# Northline Audio project guidance

- Keep the site centered on the producer portfolio and booking inquiry workflow.
- Keep sample project credits clearly identified until replaced with real credits.
- Treat booking form submission as email-draft preparation; there is no backend delivery.
- Preserve visible attribution for the CC BY 2.0 reference photo or replace it with an owned asset.
- Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` after source changes.
